// executeSequenceAtom runs one atom through the ordinary single-effect
// dispatch by wrapping it in a synthetic stack object. grant_ability is
// dispatched here directly (its template lives on the atom, not in the
// value map).
func (gs *GameState) executeSequenceAtom(controller int, source *Card, atom *EffectAtomSpec, targets []Target) error {
	return gs.executeSequenceAtomEv(controller, source, atom, targets, nil, -1)
}

func (gs *GameState) executeSequenceAtomEv(controller int, source *Card, atom *EffectAtomSpec, targets []Target, eventCard *Card, eventPlayer int) error {
	// binding round: resolve amount_ref from the sequence slots before the
	// executor sees the value (copy-not-mutate, like resolveDynamicAmount).
	if ref, _ := atom.EffectValue["amount_ref"].(string); ref != "" && gs.seqSlots != nil {
		if v, ok := gs.seqSlots[ref]; ok {
			ev := make(map[string]interface{}, len(atom.EffectValue))
			for k, val := range atom.EffectValue {
				ev[k] = val
			}
			delete(ev, "amount_ref")
			ev["amount"] = v
			a2 := *atom
			a2.EffectValue = ev
			atom = &a2
		}
	}
	// chosen-value-ref folds ([VOCAB] #1961): resolve color_ref/subtype_ref
	// from the string slots, same copy-not-mutate discipline as amount_ref.
	// target_scratch_ref (scratch-binding round, 2026-08-09,
	// docs/phase-rs-cross-reference-plan.md) is the same fold applied to a
	// CARD reference instead of a color/subtype string — "put N counters on
	// THAT CREATURE" where "that creature" is a prior atom's result
	// (manifest_dread's card, currently the only producer): resolves to
	// target_id, which put_counters' executor (game/ability_effects.go
	// executePutCounterEffect) checks before its target_self/filter/each
	// branches.
	for refKey, tgtKey := range map[string]string{"color_ref": "color", "subtype_ref": "subtype", "target_scratch_ref": "target_id"} {
		if ref, _ := atom.EffectValue[refKey].(string); ref != "" && gs.seqSlotsStr != nil {
			if v, ok := gs.seqSlotsStr[ref]; ok {
				ev := make(map[string]interface{}, len(atom.EffectValue))
				for k, val := range atom.EffectValue {
					ev[k] = val
				}
				delete(ev, refKey)
				ev[tgtKey] = v
				a2 := *atom
				a2.EffectValue = ev
				atom = &a2
			}
		}
	}
	if atom.Effect == "grant_ability" && atom.GrantedActivated != nil {
		return gs.executeGrantAbility(controller, source, atom, targets)
	}
	obj := &StackObject{
		Card:           source,
		Controller:     controller,
		IsAbility:      true,
		Text:           atom.Effect,
		EffectValue:    atom.EffectValue,
		Targets:        targets,
		EventCard:      eventCard,
		EventPlayer:    eventPlayer,
		HasEventPlayer: eventPlayer >= 0,
	}
	return gs.ExecuteAbilityEffect(obj)
}

// routeSeqTargets decides which atoms of a sequence receive the stack
// object's targets (trigger-target round 2026-08-03). When ANY atom carries
// its own TargetType marker, targets go ONLY to marked atoms — an untargeted
// rider ("...and you gain 2 life") must not consume a player target. When NO
// atom is marked (legacy records; activated ability.Target promotion), every
// atom receives them, preserving pre-round behavior.
func routeSeqTargets(atoms []EffectAtomSpec, atom *EffectAtomSpec, targets []Target) []Target {
	anyMarked := false
	for i := range atoms {
		if atoms[i].TargetType != "" {
			anyMarked = true
			break
		}
	}

		for _, card := range gs.Battlefield.GetCreatures(controller) {
			if card.Attacking {
				candidates = append(candidates, card)
			}
		}
	}
	for _, card := range candidates {
		gs.AddCounters(card, CounterPlusOnePlusOne, 2)
		gs.AddCounters(card, CounterFlying, 1)
		// "becomes an Angel in addition to its other types" — add permanently
		hasAngel := false
		for _, st := range card.SubTypes {
			if strings.EqualFold(st, "Angel") {
				hasAngel = true
				break
			}
		}
		if !hasAngel {
			card.SubTypes = append(card.SubTypes, "Angel")
		}
	}
	return nil

func (gs *GameState) executeDrawEffect(controller int, effectValue map[string]interface{}, targets []Target) error {
	amount := getIntValue(effectValue, "amount", 1)
	if amount <= 0 {

	// verb_unmapped:p_draw / "target player"/"that player" family): a
	// player-type target — either interactively chosen for "target player
	// draws a card" (Lore Weaver, Xira Arien; ActivatedAbility.Target is
	// already wired into stackObj.Targets) or bound via a target_ref
	// rewrite like event_player for "that player" (Archivist of Gondor's
	// monarch end-step trigger; see ExecuteAbilityEffect above) — overrides
	// the controller/opponent default below.
	for _, t := range targets {
		if !t.IsCard && t.PlayerIdx >= 0 && t.PlayerIdx < len(gs.Players) {
			return gs.DrawCardsWithEvent(t.PlayerIdx, amount)
		}
	}

	targetPlayer := controller
	if targetType, ok := effectValue["target"].(string); ok && targetType == "opponent" {
		targetPlayer = 1 - controller
	}
	return gs.DrawCardsWithEvent(targetPlayer, amount)
}

// TestExecuteDrawEffect_TargetPlayer (ticket #3241, REPARSE-MAP
// verb_unmapped:p_draw / draw_target_player primitive): "Target player draws
// N cards." (Lore Weaver, Xira Arien) — a player-type target already present
// in stackObj.Targets (the activated-ability interactive target picker path)

func TestExecuteDrawEffect_TargetPlayer(t *testing.T) {
	gs := NewGame("P0", "P1", false)
	source := NewCreature("Test Draw Source", ManaCost{}, 1, 1, 0)
	source.Owner, source.Controller = 0, 0
	gs.Battlefield.AddCard(source)

	before0 := len(gs.Players[0].Hand.GetAll())
	before1 := len(gs.Players[1].Hand.GetAll())

	stackObj := &StackObject{
		IsAbility:   true,
		Text:        "draw",
		Controller:  0,
		Card:        source,
		EffectValue: map[string]interface{}{"amount": float64(2)},
		Targets:     []Target{{IsCard: false, PlayerIdx: 1}},
	}

	if err := gs.ExecuteAbilityEffect(stackObj); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ExecuteAbilityEffect: %v", err)
	}

	after0 := len(gs.Players[0].Hand.GetAll())
	after1 := len(gs.Players[1].Hand.GetAll())

	if after1-before1 != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("target player (idx 1) drew %d cards, want 2", after1-before1)
	}
	if after0 != before0 {
		t.Fatalf("controller (idx 0) hand changed by %d, want 0 (target player should draw instead)", after0-before0)
	}
}

func TestToilParse(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	p := NewParser()

	for i := range result.Abilities {
		a := &result.Abilities[i]
		if a.Type != "spell" {
			continue
		}
		switch a.Effect {
		case "draw":
			draw = a
		case "player_loses_life":
			loseLife = a
		}
	}

	if draw == nil {
		t.Fatalf("missing draw spell effect; got %+v", result.Abilities)
	}
	if amt, _ := draw.Value["amount"].(int); amt != 2 {
		t.Errorf("draw: want amount 2, got %v", draw.Value["amount"])
	}
	if draw.Target == nil || draw.Target.Filter != "player" {

	if amt, _ := loseLife.Value["amount"].(int); amt != 2 {
		t.Errorf("player_loses_life: want amount 2, got %v", loseLife.Value["amount"])
	}
	if loseLife.Target == nil || loseLife.Target.Filter != "player" {
		t.Errorf("player_loses_life: want Target player, got %+v", loseLife.Target)

// Regression test for task-4142. The third line had no pattern.
func TestSazacapsBrewParsing(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	p := NewParser()
	def := &CardDefinition{
		Name: "Sazacap's Brew",
		Type: "Instant",
		Text: "Gift a tapped Fish (You may promise an opponent a gift as you cast this spell. If you do, they create a tapped 1/1 blue Fish creature token before its other effects.)\nAs an additional cost to cast this spell, discard a card.\nTarget player draws two cards. If the gift was promised, target creature you control gets +2/+0 until end of turn.",
	}
	p.ParseCard(def)

	if len(def.ParseErrors) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected parse errors: %v", def.ParseErrors)
	}

	var gift, costDecl, draw, pump *AbilityDSL
	for i := range def.Abilities {
		ab := &def.Abilities[i]
		switch {
		case ab.Effect == "gift_keyword":
			gift = ab
		case ab.Type == "cost_declaration" && ab.Effect == "discard_card":

		case ab.Effect == "draw":
			draw = ab
		case ab.Effect == "pump_until_eot":
			pump = ab
		}
	}

	if gift == nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected gift_keyword static ability; got abilities: %+v", def.Abilities)
	}

// Shape behavioral tests (docs/review.md follow-up: "one test per SHAPE,
// not per record card"). Each trigger x effect combination the record tier
// uses is proven here ONCE, end-to-end through the real pipeline:
// AbilityDSL record -> ToGameCard -> RegisterCardAbilities -> event ->
// stack -> resolution -> observable game-state change. Individual record
// cards then need no behavioral test of their own — the record linter
// (carddb_lint_test.go) guarantees they only use shapes proven here.
//
// When a worker's SHAPE_DEMAND gets built, the builder adds the new
// shape's test to this file — that is part of what "building a shape"
// means (mirroring how a VOCAB primitive ships with its lib_*_test.go).

// shapeCard builds a minimal creature CardDefinition carrying the given
// abilities, converts it, puts it onto the battlefield, and returns the
// game plus the card. No carddb dependency — shapes are tested from
// records constructed inline.
func shapeCard(t *testing.T, abilities []AbilityDSL) (*game.GameState, *game.Card) {
	t.Helper()
	p, tough := 2, 2
	def := &CardDefinition{
		Name:      "Shape Test Subject",
		Type:      "Creature",
		Types:     []string{"Creature"},
		Power:     &p,
		Toughness: &tough,
		Abilities: abilities,
		Status:    StatusManual,
	}
	card, err := def.ToGameCard(0)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ToGameCard: %v", err)
	}
	gs := game.NewGame("P0", "P1", false)
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		gs.Players[0].Library.AddCard(game.NewCard(fmt.Sprintf("Plains %d", i), game.TypeLand, game.ManaCost{}, 0))
	}
	gs.Battlefield.AddCard(card)
	gs.RegisterCardAbilities(card)
	return gs, card
}

// fire publishes an event, then resolves everything it put on the stack.
func fire(t *testing.T, gs *game.GameState, ev *game.Event) {
	t.Helper()
	gs.ProcessTriggeredAbilities(ev)
	for !gs.Stack.IsEmpty() {
		if err := gs.ResolveTopOfStack(); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("resolving trigger: %v", err)
		}
	}
}

// Package cards - DSL Type Definitions
// Defines all types used for card ability representation
package cards

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"magic-backend/game"
	"time"

// ============================================================================
// CARD STATUS
// ============================================================================

// CardStatus represents the review status of a card definition
type CardStatus string

const (
	StatusAutoParsed  CardStatus = "auto"        // Parser erfolgreich
	StatusNeedsReview CardStatus = "review"      // Parser unsicher, braucht Review
	StatusManual      CardStatus = "manual"      // Manuell korrigiert
	StatusVerified    CardStatus = "verified"    // Geprüft & freigegeben
	StatusUnsupported CardStatus = "unsupported" // Nicht unterstützt (zu komplex)
)

// ============================================================================
// ABILITY DSL
// ============================================================================

// AbilityDSL represents a parsed ability in DSL format
type AbilityDSL struct {
	Type    string                 `json:"type"`              // static, triggered, activated, spell
	Effect  string                 `json:"effect"`            // pump, grant, damage, draw, destroy, etc.
	Value   map[string]interface{} `json:"value,omitempty"`   // {power: 1, toughness: 1}
	Keyword string                 `json:"keyword,omitempty"` // for grant effects
	Trigger string                 `json:"trigger,omitempty"` // etb, dies, attacks, upkeep
	Cost    *AbilityCost           `json:"cost,omitempty"`    // for activated abilities
	Affects *TargetFilter          `json:"affects,omitempty"` // who is affected
	Target  *TargetFilter          `json:"target,omitempty"`  // targeting requirements

	// ---- Paragraph Schema v2 (docs/paragraph-schema-v2.md, adapter step 3a) ----
	// All optional; absent on every v1 record. Use DerivedTrigger()/
	// DerivedEffects() to read the v2 view regardless of record generation.
	TriggerV2 *TriggerSpec `json:"trigger_v2,omitempty"` // factored trigger object (Change 1)
	Effects   []EffectAtom `json:"effects,omitempty"`    // ordered effect sequence (Change 3)
	Condition *Condition   `json:"condition,omitempty"`  // "as long as ..." for statics (Change 2)
}

// AbilityCost represents the cost of an activated ability
type AbilityCost struct {
	Tap            bool          `json:"tap,omitempty"`
	Untap          bool          `json:"untap,omitempty"` // {Q} — untap this permanent as cost
	Mana           game.ManaCost `json:"mana,omitempty"`
	Sacrifice      string        `json:"sacrifice,omitempty"`       // "creature", "permanent", "self", etc.
	SacrificeCount int           `json:"sacrifice_count,omitempty"` // number to sacrifice (default 1, e.g. "Sacrifice two Blood tokens")
	Life           int           `json:"life,omitempty"`
	Energy         int           `json:"energy,omitempty"`       // Pay N {E} (Rule 106.11)
	DiscardSelf    bool          `json:"discard_self,omitempty"` // Discard this card (Channel etc.)
	DiscardN       int           `json:"discard_n,omitempty"`    // Discard N cards as cost
	DiscardHand    bool          `json:"discard_hand,omitempty"` // Discard your hand as cost (e.g. Lion's Eye Diamond)
	MillN          int           `json:"mill_n,omitempty"`       // Mill N cards from your own library as cost (e.g. "Mill a card:", "Mill two cards:")
	Additional     string        `json:"additional,omitempty"`   // "tap_another_creature", "discard", etc.
	Restriction    string        `json:"restriction,omitempty"`  // "metalcraft", "threshold:3:artifact", etc.

	// TapOther: "Tap another/an untapped X you control" — a SINGLE permanent,
	// chosen by the activating player (a real choice — see
	// game.ActivationCost.TapOther), as opposed to TapOthers below which
	// taps a fixed COUNT where which ones is not a meaningful choice.
	// Closed-vocabulary string, "_"-joined (matchSimpleTapType): base type
	// (creature/artifact/land/enchantment/planeswalker/permanent),
	// "legendary" qualifier, a color name, or a subtype — e.g.
	// "legendary_creature", "blue_creature", "wizard".
	TapOther string `json:"tap_other,omitempty"`

	// ReturnOther: "Return a/an/another X you control to its owner's hand"
	// as an activation cost — the SINGLE-permanent, player-chosen sibling
	// of ReturnToHand below (which carries a TargetFilter+Count but is not
	// wired to game.ActivationCost at all — no declarative pathway exists
	// for a non-self return-to-hand cost). Same closed vocabulary as
	// TapOther (game.ActivationCost.ReturnOther / matchesReturnOtherType,
	// which reuses matchSimpleTapType), just without the untapped
	// requirement — e.g. "artifact", "land", "legendary_creature".
	ReturnOther string `json:"return_other,omitempty"`

	// ---- Paragraph Schema v2 cost extensions (Change 6, adapter step 3a) ----
	RemoveCounters *CounterCost   `json:"remove_counters,omitempty"` // Remove N TYPE counters from X
	TapOthers      *TapOthersCost `json:"tap_others,omitempty"`      // Tap N untapped X you control
	ExileCost      *ExileCost     `json:"exile,omitempty"`           // Exile self/N cards from zone
	ReturnToHand   *ReturnCost    `json:"return_to_hand,omitempty"`  // Return X to owner's hand
	Tag            string         `json:"tag,omitempty"`             // exhaust|boast|forecast|... (closed)
	RestrictionV2  string         `json:"restriction_v2,omitempty"`  // V2CostRestrictions enum
	Condition      *Condition     `json:"cost_condition,omitempty"`  // "Activate only if ..."

package game

import "testing"

// TestExecuteDrawEffect_TargetPlayer (ticket #3241, REPARSE-MAP
// verb_unmapped:p_draw / draw_target_player primitive): "Target player draws
// N cards." (Lore Weaver, Xira Arien) — a player-type target already present
// in stackObj.Targets (the activated-ability interactive target picker path)
// must make the TARGET player draw, not the controller.
func TestExecuteDrawEffect_TargetPlayer(t *testing.T) {
	gs := NewGame("P0", "P1", false)
	source := NewCreature("Test Draw Source", ManaCost{}, 1, 1, 0)
	source.Owner, source.Controller = 0, 0
	gs.Battlefield.AddCard(source)

	before0 := len(gs.Players[0].Hand.GetAll())
	before1 := len(gs.Players[1].Hand.GetAll())

	stackObj := &StackObject{
		IsAbility:   true,
		Text:        "draw",
		Controller:  0,
		Card:        source,
		EffectValue: map[string]interface{}{"amount": float64(2)},
		Targets:     []Target{{IsCard: false, PlayerIdx: 1}},
	}

	if err := gs.ExecuteAbilityEffect(stackObj); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ExecuteAbilityEffect: %v", err)
	}

	after0 := len(gs.Players[0].Hand.GetAll())
	after1 := len(gs.Players[1].Hand.GetAll())

	if after1-before1 != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("target player (idx 1) drew %d cards, want 2", after1-before1)
	}
	if after0 != before0 {
		t.Fatalf("controller (idx 0) hand changed by %d, want 0 (target player should draw instead)", after0-before0)
	}
}

// "At the beginning of the monarch's end step, that player draws a card." —
// "that player" binds via target_ref=="event_player" (already rewritten into
// a player Target by ExecuteAbilityEffect) rather than an interactively
// chosen target.
func TestExecuteDrawEffect_EventPlayerRef(t *testing.T) {
	gs := NewGame("P0", "P1", false)
	source := NewCreature("Test Monarch Source", ManaCost{}, 1, 1, 0)
	source.Owner, source.Controller = 0, 0
	gs.Battlefield.AddCard(source)

	before1 := len(gs.Players[1].Hand.GetAll())

	stackObj := &StackObject{
		IsAbility:      true,
		Text:           "draw",
		Controller:     0,
		Card:           source,
		EffectValue:    map[string]interface{}{"target_ref": "event_player", "amount": float64(1)},
		HasEventPlayer: true,
		EventPlayer:    1,
	}

	if err := gs.ExecuteAbilityEffect(stackObj); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ExecuteAbilityEffect: %v", err)
	}

	after1 := len(gs.Players[1].Hand.GetAll())
	if after1-before1 != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("event-player target (idx 1, the monarch) drew %d cards, want 1", after1-before1)
	}
}

import sys
import unittest


sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path(__file__).parent))
import reparse  # noqa: E402


class DamageRecipientCountTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def map_damage(self, text):
        verb, args = reparse.O.parse_atom(text)
        self.assertEqual(verb, "damage")
        return reparse.map_atom(verb, args, kind="triggered")

    def test_each_player_uses_recipient_land_count(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            self.map_damage(
                "~ deals damage to each player equal to the number of lands they control."
            ),
            (
                "damage",
                {
                    "target": "each_player",
                    "each_player_amount_count": {
                        "count": "battlefield",
                        "filter": "land",
                        "controller": "you",
                    },
                },
                None,
            ),
        )

    def test_each_opponent_uses_recipient_land_count(self):
        effect, value, target = self.map_damage(
            "~ deals damage to each opponent equal to the number of lands they control."
        )
        self.assertEqual(effect, "damage")
        self.assertEqual(value["target"], "each_opponent")
        self.assertEqual(value["each_player_amount_count"]["controller"], "you")
        self.assertIsNone(target)

    def test_target_player_uses_targets_nonbasic_lands(self):
        effect, value, target = self.map_damage(
            "~ deals damage to target player equal to the number of nonbasic lands they control."
        )
        self.assertEqual(effect, "damage")
        self.assertTrue(value["each_player_amount_count"]["nonbasic"])
        self.assertEqual(target, {"filter": "player"})

    def test_upkeep_that_player_binds_event_player(self):
        result = reparse.reparse_card(reparse.load_card("Primal Order"))

        effect = result["abilities"][0]["effects"][0]
        self.assertEqual(effect["effect"], "damage")
        self.assertEqual(effect["value"]["target_ref"], "event_player")
        self.assertTrue(
            effect["value"]["each_player_amount_count"]["nonbasic"]
        )

// PlayLandWithChoice plays a land, applying any EtbChoice the card has.
// payOption mirrors the option list for shock lands etc. ("pay_life" =
// pay the life cost to enter untapped; "" = decline → enters tapped).
// For Cavern-of-Souls-style lands (EtbChooseCreatureType == true) payOption
// is the creature type name chosen by the player (e.g. "Eldrazi", "Human").
func (gs *GameState) PlayLandWithChoice(playerIdx int, cardID, payOption string) error {
	player := gs.GetPlayer(playerIdx)
	if player == nil {
		return errors.New("invalid player")
	}
	if gs.PrioritySystem.GetPriorityPlayer() != playerIdx {
		return errors.New("you don't have priority")
	}
	if !gs.PhaseManager.IsMainPhase() || !gs.Stack.IsEmpty() {
		return errors.New("can only play lands during main phase with empty stack")
	}
	if gs.ActivePlayerIdx != playerIdx {
		return errors.New("can only play lands on your own turn")
	}

	// Peek at the land before moving it so we can check EtbChoice.
	card, err := player.Hand.GetCard(cardID)
	if err != nil {
		return err

// task-2464 (verb_unmapped:exile): bare Oxford/OR type-word union target
// ("exile target artifact or enchantment" — Devout Chaplain). Mirrors
// 'destroy's identical _target_type_union widening — the SAME "_or_"-joined
// bucket riding matchesPermanentFilter's split-on-"_or_" fallback
// (game/targeting.go task-1968), now proven for 'exile' too: an artifact
// target and an enchantment target are both legal, a bare creature isn't.
func TestShape_Spell_ExileTargetTypeUnion(t *testing.T) {
	def := &CardDefinition{
		Name:  "Shape Devout Chaplain Spell",
		Type:  "Instant",
		Types: []string{"Instant"},
		Abilities: []AbilityDSL{
			{Type: "spell", Effect: "exile", Target: &TargetFilter{Filter: "artifact_or_enchantment"}},
		},
		Status: StatusManual,
	}
	spell, err := def.ToGameCard(0)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ToGameCard: %v", err)
	}
	gs := game.NewGame("P0", "P1", false)
	artifact := game.NewCard("Shape Union Artifact", game.TypeArtifact, game.ManaCost{}, 1)
	artifact.Controller = 1
	gs.Battlefield.AddCard(artifact)
	gs.Players[0].Hand.AddCard(spell)
	if err := gs.CastSpellWithTargets(0, spell.ID, []game.Target{{IsCard: true, CardID: artifact.ID}}); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("cast targeting the artifact half of the union: %v", err)
	}
	for !gs.Stack.IsEmpty() {
		if err := gs.ResolveTopOfStack(); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("resolve: %v", err)
		}
	}
	if _, err := gs.Battlefield.GetCard(artifact.ID); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("exile target artifact_or_enchantment: artifact still on battlefield")
	}
	if _, err := gs.Players[1].Exile.GetCard(artifact.ID); err != nil {
		t.Fatal("exile target artifact_or_enchantment: artifact not in owner's exile zone")
	}

	// A bare creature — outside the union — must never be a legal target.
	spell2, err := def.ToGameCard(0)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ToGameCard: %v", err)
	}
	creature := game.NewCreature("Shape Union Creature", game.ManaCost{}, 2, 2, 1)
	creature.Controller = 1
	gs.Battlefield.AddCard(creature)
	gs.Players[0].Hand.AddCard(spell2)
	if err := gs.CastSpellWithTargets(0, spell2.ID, []game.Target{{IsCard: true, CardID: creature.ID}}); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("exile target artifact_or_enchantment: creature accepted as a legal target")
	}
}

// TestShape_Spell_ExtraTurn: the registry-referenced shape. who:"you"
// (Time Walk) — cast, resolve, the CASTER's queue gains value.count turns.
func TestShape_Spell_ExtraTurn(t *testing.T) {
	if !EffectAllowed("extra_turn") {
		t.Fatal("extra_turn must be registered vocabulary")
	}
	def := &CardDefinition{
		Name:  "Shape Time Walk",
		Type:  "Sorcery",
		Types: []string{"Sorcery"},
		Abilities: []AbilityDSL{
			{Type: "spell", Effect: "extra_turn",
				Value: map[string]interface{}{"who": "you", "count": 1}},
		},
		Status: StatusManual,
	}
	spell, err := def.ToGameCard(0)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ToGameCard: %v", err)
	}
	if spell.SpellEffect == nil || spell.SpellEffect.Type != "extra_turn" {
		t.Fatalf("record not consumed: SpellEffect=%+v", spell.SpellEffect)
	}
	if spell.SpellEffect.Amount != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("count not lifted: Amount=%d want 1", spell.SpellEffect.Amount)
	}
	if spell.SpellEffect.SpellTargetType != "" {
		t.Fatalf("who:you must not target: SpellTargetType=%q", spell.SpellEffect.SpellTargetType)
	}

	gs := game.NewGame("P0", "P1", false)
	gs.PhaseManager.CurrentPhase = game.Phase{Type: game.PhaseMain1, Step: game.StepMain}
	gs.PrioritySystem.SetActivePlayer(0)
	gs.GameStarted = true
	gs.Players[0].Hand.AddCard(spell)
	if err := gs.CastSpellWithTargets(0, spell.ID, nil); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("cast: %v", err)
	}
	if err := gs.ResolveTopOfStack(); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("resolve: %v", err)
	}
	if got := gs.Players[0].PendingExtraTurns; got != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("caster PendingExtraTurns=%d want 1", got)
	}
	if got := gs.Players[1].PendingExtraTurns; got != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("opponent PendingExtraTurns=%d want 0", got)
	}
}

def _parse_grant_activated_body(quoted_text):
    """Quoted ability text -> AbilityDSL dict if it maps CLEAN (zero misses)
    as exactly one ACTIVATED ability whose targets survive conversion, else
    None. Loyalty-ability bodies ("[0]: ..."), spend-restriction mana
    ("Spend this mana only ..."), and anything with a miss fall out of the
    round-trip naturally — honest residue, same re-queue bucket."""
    fake = {'name': '', 'text': quoted_text, 'types': ['Creature']}
    r = reparse_card(fake)
    if r['misses'] or len(r['abilities']) != 1:
        return None
    ab = r['abilities'][0]
    if ab.get('type') != 'activated':
        return None
    if not _grant_body_targets_clean(quoted_text, ab):
        return None
    return ab

def load_card(name):
    letter = (name[0].lower() if name[0].isalpha() else '0')
    path = os.path.join(CARDDB, f'{letter}.json')
    if not os.path.exists(path): return None
    db = json.load(open(path))

def _emit_triggered(abilities, ab, spec):
    """Append a triggered ability; if spec carries compound_events (an
    'whenever you <evA> or <evB>' compound — cycle-or-discard class,
    task-2380), clone the finished ability once per additional event so the
    engine fires on EITHER. Cycling does not publish EventDiscard
    (keyword_abilities.go CycleCard fires only EventCycle), and the engine
    can't OR two events on one TriggerCondition, so two separate triggered
    abilities with the same body is the exact OR semantics — disjoint
    events, no double-fire. Subject and body are shared across clones (the
    compound is OR-of-events only); the clone just swaps trigger_v2.event.

    task-2417: compound_zones is the same OR-of-disjoint-events idea for a
    cast_spell trigger restricted to "anywhere other than hand" — the event
    itself is always 'cast_spell', but trigger_v2.spell.zone is what the Go
    converter reads to pick the concrete EventSpellCastFrom{Graveyard,Exile,
    Library} (every non-hand cast path publishes its own zone event, so the
    three are exhaustively disjoint and non-overlapping). Unlike
    compound_events there is no unmodified "base" firing — the raw spell
    filter with no zone would convert to the generic EventSpellCast, which
    fires on hand casts too — so every clone here carries an explicit zone
    and nothing unzoned is ever appended."""
    zones = spec.get('compound_zones')
    if zones:
        for z in zones:
            abz = json.loads(json.dumps(ab))
            abz['trigger_v2']['spell']['zone'] = z
            abilities.append(abz)
        return
    abilities.append(ab)
    extra = spec.get('compound_events')
    if not extra:
        return
    base = ab.get('trigger_v2', {}).get('event')
    for ev in extra:
        if ev == base:
            continue
        ab2 = json.loads(json.dumps(ab))
        ab2['trigger_v2']['event'] = ev
        abilities.append(ab2)
